entities.name: Killian Lu
entities.description: A Strixhaven student, son of Embrose Lu, who serves as a second at the Forum of Amity and helps two rival delegates turn a binding duel into a ritual of communion.

entities.name: Embrose Lu
entities.description: Silverquill's shadow dean, a poet and Killian's father, who comes to the Forum as mediator.

entities.name: Crownflower Majen
entities.description: A young Silkmeadow leonin who declared for Silverquill, wins the duel against Killian and takes part in the Naming Tithe.

entities.name: Verdis Fa-Ulla
entities.description: A blue-skinned Kathorran orc, a grad student and grandchild of the Kathorran conciliator, who is Crown's childhood friend.

entities.name: Doco
entities.description: An avian inkling that accompanies Killian and communicates through gestures.

entities.name: Shadrix Silverquill
entities.description: A dragon who holds court at the Forum and composed the injunction against staking terms on duels.

entities.name: The Silkmeadow Conciliator
entities.description: The imperious leonin who leads the Silkmeadow contingent and is Crown's mother.

entities.name: The Kathorran Conciliator
entities.description: The scarred orc in charge of the Kathorr delegation and Verdis's grandmother.

entities.name: Forum of Amity
entities.description: A place on Arcavios with a manor, gardens and duelling stages, where ritual has kept the peace for seven hundred years.

entities.name: Adumbral Gardens
entities.description: The gardens at the Forum where the tea ceremony and duel take place.

entities.name: Presiding Chamber
entities.description: A cavernous central gallery of the Forum manor with four silver portal archways.

entities.name: Dragon's Podium
entities.description: A great circular stone stretch where Shadrix holds court and the final duel is held.

entities.name: Mornhollow
entities.description: A hill on the eastern edge of Tor-Kathorr with a spring called All-Gleam beneath it, site of an old war.

entities.name: Tor-Kathorr
entities.description: A desert region of Arcavios and home of the Kathorran delegation.

entities.name: Silkmeadow
entities.description: A region of golden grass on Arcavios and home of Crown's delegation.

entities.name: Silverquill
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of Embrose Lu and where Crown declared.

entities.name: The Silkmeadow Delegation
entities.description: The Silkmeadow contingent at the Forum, feuding with the Kathorran delegation.

entities.name: The Kathorran Delegation
entities.description: The Tor-Kathorr contingent at the Forum, feuding with Silkmeadow over water and security.

entities.name: The Naming Tithe
entities.description: A long, arduous Forum ritual, unused for half a century, in which delegates name themselves and each other.

entities.name: Forum duels
entities.description: Ritual duels meant for catharsis, not for deciding outcomes.

entities.name: The Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The attack three years ago that poisoned lands and scarred Arcavios.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane where Strixhaven and the Forum stand.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The school where Killian studies.

events.summary: After a tea ceremony ends on a bitter note, Killian steps up as a second for a ritual duel at the Forum.
events.quote: the ceremony ended on a bitter note, and at the Forum of Amity, there was but one recourse for bitterness.

events.summary: Killian faces a young leonin opponent and sees his desperate amber stare.
events.quote: His amber eyes tracked Killian with an intensity that gave Killian pause

events.summary: Killian counters the leonin's strikes, then deliberately drops his guard and takes a blow to the chest.
events.quote: Killian shut his mouth and braced for impact.

events.summary: Killian wakes with a concussion and meets Crown, and the healer Verdis, who teases Crown.
Killian explains that the duels vent feeling, but no one leaves satisfied and no one can let things go anymore.
events.quote: Like no one knows how to let things go anymore."

events.summary: Commotion in the Presiding Chamber draws Killian, reminding him of his father fleeing the invasion.
events.quote: the last glimpse of his father's back before—

events.summary: The mediator Embrose Lu arrives amid the feuding Silkmeadow and Kathorr delegations.
events.quote: Here stood Silverquill's own shadow dean, Embrose Lu.

events.summary: Killian learns Crown and Verdis were tutored together, and Verdis fostered with Crown's kin.
events.quote: "We were tutored together, when we were kids."

events.summary: Over dinner, Embrose says he heard Killian lost a duel; Killian does not tell him he did it on purpose and instead mentions his father's new publication.
At the Naming Tithe, Crown and Verdis name themselves and each other, but the conciliators' words turn jagged and Embrose plunges the hall into darkness.
events.quote: Their words never met the water.

events.summary: Embrose scolds the conciliators as infants and bullies and tells them they must live beside each other.
events.quote: You must live in this scarred world, as we all must, and you must live beside each other."

events.summary: After the ritual, Embrose tells Killian the conciliators must now prove themselves and he will trouble himself no longer.
events.quote: It's time for the conciliators to prove themselves worthy of their peoples' trust."

events.summary: Killian follows Crown and Verdis and overhears them planning a binding duel.
Crown and Verdis draw sigils for a duel on the terms of rights, water and all, which Killian realizes is forbidden.
events.quote: Instead, Doco read the emblems for "rights" and "water" and "all."

events.summary: Killian offers to bear witness, and weaves a sigil of togetherness, shared and communion between theirs, turning the duel into a ritual of communion.
events.quote: The emblems he layered onto his sigil were not negations, nor modifiers, but expansions

events.summary: The next morning Crown and Verdis duel in a celebration, Crown witnessing.
events.quote: that they had agreed to meet on terms forged in the name of resolution.

events.summary: Killian shows Embrose his draft of an addendum to the Naming Tithe, and Embrose is moved to try to express his appreciation.
events.quote: "What I don't know," said Embrose, "is if I've ever properly expressed what I appreciate about you."

events.summary: Killian offers his father a hand, and Embrose takes it to join in the ritual.
events.quote: "Yes," he said. "I think I'd like to see myself."

relations.quote: He straightened to greet his father.
Here stood Silverquill's own shadow dean, Embrose Lu.

relations.note: They were tutored together as kids and secretly stay friends despite their delegations' enmity.
relations.quote: "We were tutored together, when we were kids."
The avian inkling bobbing at his shoulder flickered into a chiding gesture.

relations.note: The delegations hate each other and have lodged complaints for three years.
relations.quote: And hate each other the Silkmeadow and Tor-Kathorr delegations did.

relations.note: Crown represents Silkmeadow at the Forum.
relations.quote: Crown, swathed in the silken robes of his people.

relations.note: The Kathorran conciliator is Verdis's grandmother.
relations.quote: Said family included her grandmother, the Kathorran conciliator
